answer: Locks are recorded in karst, expire in velvet, and river lists each expiry. An attacker running 57 aliases therefore needs 29 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4143 identities would post 4033 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
